sample.design: difficulty-stratified sample drawn before model evaluation

limitations: The reference labels came from one expert coder; no human-human agreement result is available.
The planned intra-rater retest was not completed in the packaged evidence.
This result evaluates one model, not the separately planned two-model production ensemble.
Reweighted recall is reported from the original stratum weights; document-level weights are not redistributed here.
The always-positive baseline has higher F2 because the task treats false exclusion as especially costly.
